source: ABCD agent guidelines (Chen et al. 2021, arXiv 2104.00783), data/guidelines.json

rules.statement: The updated refund total must be entered without a dollar sign and submitted via Offer Refund.
When a customer adds an item to an existing refund, the new total refund amount equals the previous refund amount plus the price of the new item.
Before modifying an existing refund, the agent must validate the purchase using the customer's username, email address, order ID, and phone number via Validate Purchase.
